name: Companion continuity across host lifecycles
statement: Recover the supported authorized workflow after browser worker termination, companion process death, system sleep/wake, hibernation/resume and shutdown/reboot/logon when OS, browser and user context return.
requiredProperties: event-triggered recovery, not continuous execution while powered down
support conditional OS logon startup and bounded retry

provenance.sourceReference: Owner companion recovery design 2026-10-15; Chute Windows v2.6.1 RC1 historical reference
